character_types: old man narrator with glasses and cane
key_props: kettle and jars on the counter
visual_synopsis: In a small pale-yellow kitchen a red-wigged wife in a pink satin dressing gown (visibly a male actor in drag, heavy lipstick) and a husband in a red checked shirt have a long escalating argument, moving from the counter to the wall where he corners her, gestures in her face and finally grabs her by the robe with her hands raised. The row is bracketed by an old-man character in a grey wig, tinted glasses and brown blazer, first sitting with his cane in a dark living room and then addressing the camera from a bright hallway.
